setup: A wheel makes [[revs]] complete revolutions in [[seconds]] seconds, and you are asked for its angular velocity in degrees per second.

steps.say: One revolution is a full turn of 360 degrees, so [[revs]] revolutions sweep $360 \times [[revs]]$ degrees.
Dividing that sweep by [[seconds]] seconds gives the angle turned each second: $360 \times [[revs]] \div [[seconds]] = [[answer]]$ degrees per second.

answer: So the angular velocity is [[answer]] degrees per second.
